user.title: WUD Queue
user.description: Installs What's Up Docker's container updates one at a time. There is nothing to set up. The queue works on the update entities What's Up Docker has made through MQTT.

abort.single_instance_allowed: WUD Queue is already set up.

enqueue.name: Queue updates
enqueue.description: Adds the updates of What's Up Docker update entities to the queue and starts it. WUD's own container is installed last.

entity_id.name: Update entities
entity_id.description: What's Up Docker update entities with an update waiting.

stop.name: Stop the queue
stop.description: Lets the update being installed finish, and drops the rest.

retry.name: Retry
retry.description: Queues the failed update and the ones that did not run again, and starts the queue.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Empties a queue that is not running, as happens by itself ten minutes after it has finished.

not_loaded.message: WUD Queue is not set up.

not_wud.message: {entity_id} is not an update entity of What's Up Docker.

nothing_to_install.message: None of the entities has an update waiting that is not already in the queue.

nothing_to_retry.message: The queue has nothing to retry.

running.message: The queue is running. Stop it first, or let it finish.

stopping.message: The queue is stopping. Queue the update again once it has stopped.
